The case is decided as **auto-fix**.

The investigator found, with high confidence, that the cause is in `OrderApi.GetOrderTotal` in `src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs` at line 18. The method looks up the discount code directly in the rate table. Order 1003 carries the retired code `SUMMER25`, which isn't in the table, so the lookup throws and blocks checkout. The runbook lists this exception as auto-fixable, with the expected behaviour of no discount (total equals subtotal).

The fix should use a `TryGetValue` fallback to the subtotal, leaving WELCOME10, VIP20 and no-code totals unchanged. The investigator also noted that `GetDiscountLabel` in `Api/DiscountLabel.cs` would print "SUMMER (25% off)" for this code even though no discount is applied. That is outside this error, so I've passed it to the reviewer as a note rather than adding it to the fix.

I couldn't brief the coder directly: its address isn't among the agents I may call, so the decision hands the fix to the coder through the run. The reviewer's check comes after the coder's branch is in.
